name: FatesCrossed
source:
"After a strange event that happened a few years ago, the protagonist lost his mother, and would probably still be living on the streets if it wasn't for the help of a mysterious girl named Lilly. She and her best friend took the Protagonist in, in exchange for his help since she had lost her body and he is the only one who could see her!

The search for the Protagonist's mother led to nothing but more disappointment. And so it would have continued until he received a fateful letter that changed everything."

"Now, he has to attend school while trying to uncover the truth behind the past events."

[From [URL=https://vitayok.itch.io/fatescrossed]itch.io[/URL]]
